speaker: Doctor
text: The lab results show predominantly unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, which rules out biliary atresia and makes the family history of liver surgery less likely to be directly related to this specific presentation. Since the baby is gaining weight, feeding well, and has normal stooling patterns, this is consistent with benign breast milk jaundice. DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast milk jaundice
